name: texel
description: Renders math, typst and diagrams inline in the Claude Code transcript

mathColor.title: Math colour
mathColor.description: Colour of LaTeX math, inline and display, as hex (#b3bd5a); empty for the text colour.

typstColor.title: Typst block colour
typstColor.description: Colour of typst blocks' text, as hex; empty for the text colour.

inlineSize.title: Inline math size
inlineSize.description: Inline math's size against the terminal text: 1 matches its x-height.

inlineMaxScale.title: Inline math: largest scale
inlineMaxScale.description: How far a formula smaller than its row may grow to fill it (1: never).

inlineMinScale.title: Inline math: smallest scale
inlineMinScale.description: How far a formula may shrink before its line gains a row instead.

inlineShiftUp.title: Inline math: shift up (rows)
inlineShiftUp.description: How far above the text's baseline a formula may sit to save a row.

inlineShiftDown.title: Inline math: shift down (rows)
inlineShiftDown.description: How far below the text's baseline a formula may sit to save a row.
